Two live HTTP calls were made via supabase-js with the anon key (the exact client calling convention rosterPatchProposalService.ts itself uses), BOTH designed and confirmed to fail before ever reaching buildSystemPrompt/callOpenAI/callGemini: (1) a wrong/never-issued admin_access_code -> confirmed live response {"status":"invalid_admin_code"} (proves the service-role RPC path to verify_chief_admin_code works end-to-end in production for the rejection case, and that request rejection happens correctly); (2) a valid synthetic admin_access_code with an empty instruction -> confirmed live response {"status":"invalid_request","message":"instruction is required."} (proves request validation rejects malformed input -- this check never reaches verify_chief_admin_code at all, since index.ts validates instruction presence before admin-code verification, confirmed by source read and by tenant_ai_usage staying empty for the synthetic tenant afterward).
